source_groups.scope: Shared Blender helper module; code signatures are indexed without importing bpy.

entries.name: Configurable operable cabinet
entries.description: Operable cabinet generator: explicit layouts support weighted columns/sections, variable drawer counts/heights, single/double doors, shelves and interior dividers. Omitting layout preserves the original two-door/one-drawer interface.

reuse.limitations: Blender runtime; metres, local -Y front, floor Z=0. Each size component must be at least 0.2 m. Inspect clearance when animating.

entries.name: Beveled box
entries.description: Box generator with explicit dimensions, material, target collection and edge radius.

reuse.limitations: Blender runtime; a primitive helper, not a complete furniture asset.

entries.name: Append and place collection
entries.description: Append a named collection and place an instance with location, Z rotation and scale.

reuse.limitations: Blender runtime. Rotation uses degrees. Repeated instances share mesh data; copy it for unique geometry variants.

entries.name: Hinge or slide existing parts
entries.description: Group moving geometry around a physical pivot with an Open-property driver.

reuse.limitations: Blender runtime; requires actual separate moving objects and a correctly chosen pivot.
